# google_memorystore_instance_token_auth_user

A token based auth user for a Google Cloud Memorystore Instance.

~> **Warning:** This resource is in beta, and should be used with the terraform-provider-google-beta provider.
See [Provider Versions](../guides/provider_versions.html.markdown) for more details on beta resources.

To get more information about InstanceTokenAuthUser, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/memorystore/docs/valkey/reference/rest/v1main/projects.locations.instances.tokenAuthUsers)
* How-to Guides
    * [Official Documentation](https://cloud.google.com/memorystore/docs/valkey/)

## Example Usage - Memorystore Instance Token Auth User Basic


```hcl
resource "google_memorystore_instance" "instance" {
  provider    = google-beta
  instance_id = "instance-token-auth"
  shard_count = 1
  desired_auto_created_endpoints {
    network    = google_compute_network.producer_net.id
    project_id = data.google_project.project.project_id
  }
  location                = "us-central1"
  replica_count           = 1
  node_type               = "SHARED_CORE_NANO"
  transit_encryption_mode = "TRANSIT_ENCRYPTION_DISABLED"
  authorization_mode      = "TOKEN_AUTH"
  engine_version              = "VALKEY_7_2"
  deletion_protection_enabled = false
  mode = "CLUSTER_DISABLED"
  depends_on = [
    google_network_connectivity_service_connection_policy.default
  ]
}

resource "google_memorystore_instance_token_auth_user" "token-auth-user" {
  provider        = google-beta
  instance        = google_memorystore_instance.instance.id
  token_auth_user = "user-token-auth"
}

resource "google_network_connectivity_service_connection_policy" "default" {
  provider      = google-beta
  name          = "policy-token-auth"
  location      = "us-central1"
  service_class = "gcp-memorystore"
  description   = "my basic service connection policy"
  network       = google_compute_network.producer_net.id
  psc_config {
    subnetworks = [google_compute_subnetwork.producer_subnet.id]
  }
}

resource "google_compute_subnetwork" "producer_subnet" {
  provider      = google-beta
  name          = "subnet-token-auth"
  ip_cidr_range = "10.0.0.248/29"
  region        = "us-central1"
  network       = google_compute_network.producer_net.id
}

resource "google_compute_network" "producer_net" {
  provider                = google-beta
  name                    = "net-token-auth"
  auto_create_subnetworks = false
}

data "google_project" "project" {
  provider = google-beta
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `instance` -
  (Required)
  Required. The name of the Memorystore instance.
  Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/instances/{instance}

* `token_auth_user` -
  (Required)
  Required. The identifier of the token auth user.


* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/instances/{{instance}}/tokenAuthUsers/{{token_auth_user}}`

* `name` -
  Output only. Identifier. The resource name of the token auth user.
  Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/instances/{instance}/tokenAuthUsers/{token_auth_user}

* `state` -
  Output only. The state of the token auth user.
  Possible values: STATE_UNSPECIFIED, ACTIVE, CREATING, UPDATING, DELETING

## Import


InstanceTokenAuthUser can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/instances/{{instance}}/tokenAuthUsers/{{token_auth_user}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{instance}}/{{token_auth_user}}`
* `{{location}}/{{instance}}/{{token_auth_user}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import InstanceTokenAuthUser using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    instance = "<-required value->"
    tokenAuthUser = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_memorystore_instance_token_auth_user.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import InstanceTokenAuthUser using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/instances/{{instance}}/tokenAuthUsers/{{token_auth_user}}"
  to = google_memorystore_instance_token_auth_user.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), InstanceTokenAuthUser can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_memorystore_instance_token_auth_user.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/instances/{{instance}}/tokenAuthUsers/{{token_auth_user}}
$ terraform import google_memorystore_instance_token_auth_user.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{instance}}/{{token_auth_user}}
$ terraform import google_memorystore_instance_token_auth_user.default {{location}}/{{instance}}/{{token_auth_user}}
```
